About Patong

Patong is the main resort town on Phuket's west coast, in Kathu district. The project data places BRISA Patong by Sansiri directly behind the Jungceylon shopping mall, with Walking Street about ten minutes on foot and Patong Beach roughly 900 m away.

The completed condominiums in neighbouring Kathu, Dcondo Reef Kathu and The Origin Kathu-Patong, are listed on the Kathu page: the developer of The Origin places it between Patong Beach and the Old Town, and Dcondo Reef Kathu is about 7 km from Patong Beach.
